reference.versionEvidence: Read current installed reference Info.plist after this live playtest

completed: Opened Home level3 into restored6x6 board with two found cats and576score
Observed victory overlay with level4 available; left at victory

observations.seen: Correct reward includes small local heart, bright multicolor sparkles and region-colored fragments travelling outside the source tile, including below the board. A clapping-hands decoration and floating score accompany sampled corrects.
observations.boundary: Do not copy competitor artwork or add its English praise variants wholesale; preserve original Capydoku no-obstruction and immediate-input requirements.

observations.seen: Sampled post-restore sequence showed Patient Paws!, then Double Paws! with Nice, then Great, then Perfect on the final find. Floating increments672,768,864,960; HUD subsequently updated.
observations.boundary: Perfect is an observed label in this sampled version, not proof of Excellent or a frozen combo/scoring specification. Current formal config is unchanged.

observations.seen: Final-board cats smile with small hearts. Victory presents a large party cat with glow sticks, split blue/purple light, confetti and Chinese praise. Two later screenshots show different head/arm/body poses while the action remains visible.
observations.boundary: Two snapshots do not establish frame rate, continuous interpolation technology, loop duration or precise motion timing. Capydoku keeps its own original art and short non-blocking presentation.

implementationDecisions: Add bounded sparse board-coordinate particle arcs that cross tile edges but remain inside the board; no interaction layer or delayed score/save
Replace whole-image pose swaps with original articulated assets if assembly quality passes runtime review
Prewarm trusted existing short audio handles during loading; leave9source WAVs and volume/delay unchanged
notVerified: Formal frozen reference or complete late-game behavior
